_comment: Release notes for the published site. REPO-AUTHORED (contributed path):
edit this by hand, unlike everything under data/, exports/ and provisions/.
Add a new entry at the TOP of `releases` when you cut a release. The site
`provisions_root_hash` is the load-bearing field: it is the root of the
published hash tree at that release. If it is unchanged from the previous
entry, the composed TEXT did not change and any provision a checker
verified against that hash is still verified. Copy it from the site footer
or from publish/published-state.json after a build.
`text_version` is the date of the composed legal text (from the vault),
which is a different thing from the site version - the site can be
released many times against one text version.

releases.summary: First public release. The composed current text of the EU AI Act, published with its derivation shown per provision so it can be checked.
changes: Complete current text: 119 articles and 14 annexes, with the Digital Omnibus on AI (Regulation (EU) 2026/1744) applied.
A derivation page for each of the 72 amendment instructions: original text, the quoted official instruction, the result, and a word-level diff.
182 touched provisions, each with a derivation.json and a content hash.
The provisions/ hash tree, rolling up to a single root hash published in the site footer.
Seven download formats (PDF, HTML, Markdown, JSON, JSON-LD, Turtle, DOCX), each sha256-anchored.
Verification page: the six pipeline gates, the corrigenda finding, the composition inputs, and the review register (all provisions start not-reviewed).
Comparison against the other public versions of the Act, surveyed 2026-07-31.
Styled to match riskmandate.ai, with a link back to the parent site.
